message.reasoning:
The user asks: "2017年誰贏得了格萊美獎最佳專輯獎？" They want the winner of the Grammy Award for Best Album in 2017. That would be the award given at the 59th Annual Grammy Awards held in 2017? Actually the Grammys are awarded for works released in the previous year. The 59th Annual Grammy Awards were held in February 2017, awarding works from 2015-2016. The Best Album category is "Album of the Year". In 2017, the winner was Adele for "25"? Wait, let's recall: The 59th Grammys (Feb 12, 2017) had Album of the Year winners: Adele – "25". Yes, Adele won Album of the Year for "25" at the 59th Grammys. So answer: Adele.

But maybe they refer to "Best Album" as "Album of the Year" or "Best Album" category? There's also "Best Contemporary Folk Album", etc. But likely they mean "Album of the Year".

Thus answer: Adele.

We can provide the answer in Chinese: "阿黛尔（Adele）在2017年的格莱美奖中赢得了最佳专辑奖（Album of the Year），她的专辑《25》获得了该奖项。"
